name: Oberursel Zimmersmuehlenweg data center
notes: IHK Frankfurt policy brief says Oberursel am Taunus has a data center in the Zimmersmuehlenweg business area; local press also references an IBM data center near Gablonzer Strasse/Zimmersmuehlenweg. Capacity and operator not publicly confirmed in the sources checked.

name: DRV Hessen Koenigstein data center and office conversion
notes: Public procurement notices list planning services for 'Rechenzentrum und Umbau Dienststelle DRV Koenigstein' at Altenhainer Str. 1, Koenigstein im Taunus, NUTS DE718 Hochtaunuskreis. Institutional data center; capacity not stated.

name: ekom21 Kassel municipal data center
notes: HNA reports ekom21's statewide data center is located on Knorrstrasse in Kassel; ekom21's own site confirms Kassel as one of its offices. Municipal/government IT data center rather than hyperscale/colo; capacity not disclosed.

name: Rechenzentrum Schulte GmbH / Ricoh Asslar operations
notes: Ricoh announced continuation of Rechenzentrum Schulte GmbH operations headquartered in Asslar after acquiring operational assets. Creditreform classifies the company as operating data processing facilities for third parties. Appears to be business-process/data-processing facility, not hyperscale; capacity not disclosed.

name: OVHcloud LIM1-3 Limburg/Offheim data center
notes: City of Limburg announced OVHcloud building a new data center in the ICE area; local reporting describes OVHcloud's existing Offheim/Limburg data center with around 10,000 servers, and map data identifies OVHcloud LIM1-3 at Limburger Strasse 45. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Frank Cube Birstein data center campus
notes: Argaman Group's Frank Cube project is planned for an 11 ha site in Birstein, Main-Kinzig-Kreis, with 200 MW IT load. Later trade reporting says a citizen referendum was stopped and the project retained municipal-path approval; commissioning shifted from 2028 toward 2029/2030.

name: Google Hanau data center expansion
notes: Google opened its first Hanau data center in 2023 and announced further expansion in Hanau as part of its EUR 5.5bn Germany cloud/AI infrastructure program. Hanau separated from Main-Kinzig-Kreis in 2026, but the project is included because the batch division historically covers the Hanau/Main-Kinzig datacenter cluster.

name: DATA4 Frankfurt-Hanau campus
notes: DATA4's official Frankfurt-Hanau campus page lists 25 ha of land reserves, 180 MW available electricity reserves, and first module planned for 2025. IHK Main-Kinzig brief says the Hanau/Grossauheim-Kaserne site is expected to reach 180 MW at final build-out; local reporting records the groundbreaking in September 2025.

name: CyrusOne Frankfurt V / FRA5 Hanau
notes: CyrusOne broke ground on its newest German data center in Hanau after receiving a permit; the project is tied to a major waste-heat utilization scheme. Public sources reviewed did not disclose IT capacity for FRA5.

name: maincubes FRA03 Schwalbach data center
notes: maincubes and SPIE report the four-storey data center on Kronberger Hang in Schwalbach am Taunus; trade coverage identifies FRA03 as a 16 MW data center. Topping-out was reported in late 2025.

name: Hofheim Marxheim data center
developer: Suedwag Energie / Data Center Group / PRIME Data Centers partnership
notes: Hofheim's Bebauungsplan Nr. 150 and Regionalverband materials create the planning basis for 'Rechenzentrum Marxheim'. Data Center Group magazine describes a Hofheim data center partnership with Suedwag Energie and PRIME Data Centers. Capacity not stated in the public planning materials checked.

name: Digital Realty Hattersheim Kastengrund data center site
notes: Local and regional planning reporting says Digital Realty/Interxion acquired the former Sanofi/Kastengrund site in Hattersheim to develop a large data center and substation. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Philipps-Universitaet Marburg Hochschulrechenzentrum / MaRC3 HPC cluster
notes: University computing center has operated since 1963; current official HPC page lists MaRC3 cluster resources including data-center GPUs and multi-PB storage. Institutional HPC/data center rather than commercial colocation; capacity not disclosed.

name: Google Dietzenbach data center
notes: Google announced a new Dietzenbach data center near Frankfurt as part of a EUR 5.5bn Germany investment plan, with heat-recovery cooperation via Energieversorgung Offenbach. Dietzenbach is in Landkreis Offenbach.

name: maincubes FRA04 Dietzenbach hyperscale data center
notes: maincubes' official FRA04 page and press material place the project in Dietzenbach, list up to 40 MW IT capacity depending on design, 10,000-12,500 sqm whitespace, 60 MW secured power, and expected Q1 2029 readiness.

name: EdgeConneX EDCFRA01 Dietzenbach
notes: DCD reports DCByte tracked EdgeConneX developing EDCFRA01 on about 3.6 ha in Dietzenbach; Data Center Map gives the Waldstrasse 43-45 Dietzenbach address. DCAtlas lists 9.1 MW under construction; capacity marked B/C-level because it is from an industry database, not the developer.
